villa.title: Desert-modern villa
villa.tag: Open plan under a walnut slat ceiling, a sandstone fire wall and the desert through steel glass.

ranch.title: Ranch house
ranch.tag: Timber and stone, a leather sofa by a fieldstone fire, a cowhide rug and a long farmhouse table.

lakehouse.title: Lodge great room
lakehouse.tag: Log walls, a river rock chimney to the trusses and a sleeping loft up the timber stair.

glamp.title: Canvas bell tent
glamp.tag: A ring of poles under a cone of canvas, a wood stove, string lights down the spokes and a bed piled with quilts.

card.p: Homes like this one are where the people of Genesis live. Make yourself at home.
card.foot: Walk around: E lights the fire, dims the lamps, brews coffee and pulls a book.

books: Field Notes from the Sky Islands
Night Skies over the High Desert
A Field Guide to Desert Light
bookLines: A well-thumbed copy, a pressed ocotillo flower marking a page.
Someone has underlined half of chapter three.
The spine is cracked at the good part.
A note inside the cover: for long evenings by the fire.
A boarding pass from the old airfield tucked inside as a bookmark.
coffee: Fresh coffee. The whole house smells of it.
Coffee in a heavy mug, the way it should be.
dogLines: {dog} thumps a tail on the floor and sighs.
{dog} rolls over for a belly rub.
{dog} opens one eye, then goes back to sleep.
records: A slow country record crackles into the room.
A worn jazz record turns, low and warm.
Desert folk, a guitar and a harmonica.
pool: You sink the eight ball. Nobody saw it, so it counts.
A clean break. Three stripes drop.
The cue ball kisses the nine and stops dead.
